purpose: Pinned public interpretation benchmarks; not new default values, external calibration, legal adoption or TTC qualification.

scope.material: Tea tree oil meeting the opinion's compositional restrictions; stability matters.
scope.population: adults in the defended dermally applied cosmetic uses
scope.route: dermal systemic SED, with other routes considered separately
transfer_limits: restricted defended product types and concentrations
aerosolised or sprayable delivery is outside the favourable scope
this reference is not an exposure descriptor or aggregate population P95

cases.sensitisation_qra_disposition: SCCS could not evaluate the submitted QRA: aggregate procedure absent and face-wash use omitted.
cases.overall_disposition: Favourable conclusion for restricted defended uses and corresponding materials; distinct from the QRA shortcoming.
cases.lesson: Review completeness and endpoint scope separately. Product-specific absorption inputs differ within the same dermal route.

scope.material: Kojic acid in the tested versus intended product formulations

cases.disposition: The lower absorption result's formulation was considered insufficiently representative for intended products.
cases.lesson: Chemical identity and broad physical form do not establish formulation or contact-condition correspondence. Historical values do not become current defaults.

scope.population: Separate children age groups; EU applicability
scope.route: dermal and oral considered with separate product contributions

cases.disposition: Children-specific product-use data were used where available, with an explicit skin-surface-area fallback otherwise.
cases.lesson: Plausible infant/child defaults do not reproduce an age-specific exposure record; retain use-data, body-weight and fallback provenance.

scope.dose_basis: consumer exposure level for the relevant local skin endpoint

cases.disposition: SCCS identified the need for aggregate exposure when the respondent's CEL was based on one product but multiple uses were expected.
cases.lesson: Systemic mg/kg-day, external skin loading and local sensitisation CEL have different meanings. One-product calculations do not establish multi-product coverage.

scope.material: EHMC present at 10% in the representative formulation tested in the opinion
scope.route: dermal absorption for systemic MoS calculation
transfer_limits: No automatic transfer to another formulation, batch, concentration or use condition.
Mean plus one SD is not an aggregate or marginal P95.
No standalone safety or TTC qualification is inferred.

selection.study_method: OECD TG 428 in vitro dermal absorption

cases.disposition: SCCS used 0.45% absorption in this opinion's MoS calculation.
cases.lesson: Preserve original units, statistical construction, tested formulation and exact opinion version. POD_OTHER is an extraction label, not a hazard endpoint designation.

scope.material: Basic Blue 99 marketed material versus submitted study batches
transfer_limits: The submitted absorption study was not accepted for the assessed material.
Older-batch toxicology does not automatically characterize the new batches.
The opinion's fallback is not inserted as a universal software default.

cases.disposition: SCCS rejected the absorption study for non-representative batch and major methodological shortcomings; separate genotoxicity concerns remained.
cases.lesson: An absorption refinement cannot resolve material correspondence, study quality or independent hazard concerns.
